speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for National Development what plans does the Ministry have to encourage companies in the private sector to achieve the BCA Green Mark for Super Low Energy Buildings certification.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The response from the industry has been positive.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Through this programme, building owners and developers can work with research partners to develop innovative green technologies for building applications and conduct large-scale demonstrations to assess their feasibility in the local context.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This is an open database of green building technologies supported by building energy data and analytic tools.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The Smart Hub also has an online advisory function to recommend customised retrofitting plans for building owners and developers to green their existing buildings.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: We will continue to work with industry stakeholders to encourage companies to achieve the BCA Green Mark for Super Low Energy certification.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: The Technology Roadmap that the Minister of State was talking about, I think we started work on that since 2018.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Can I just check whether the study is completed and whether the report is available to the public?

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: In fact, the Technology Roadmap is in place.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Today, some of the technologies identified in the Roadmap are the light-emitting diode (LED) lighting with smart controls, decoupled cooling from dehumidification and thermally reflective cool paint.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Many of these solutions are novel applications of existing technologies.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: But, yes, we have also seen some of these technologies being used in some of our buildings today, for example, the Singapore Management University (SMU)-Connexion (SMU-X) building which uses an enhanced passive displacement cooling system.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: The system uses the natural convection of heat to move the cool air without the use of mechanical fans, so, therefore, reducing energy consumption.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: This helps the building achieve substantial energy savings while maintaining a comfortable environment for students.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I just want to know whether the Roadmap is available for public viewing, so people can see and give feedback, and possibly improve it as well.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: So, if the Member needs further information on the Roadmap, I am happy to provide.
